summary_text: Tested weighted-random routing against greedy-cheapest-first; weighted-random wins by 0.49 on the cost objective. Background: [@vale1986storage] motivates the cost-tuned framing.

empirical_claims.statement: Cost-tuned weighted-random routing beats greedy-cheapest-first on the cost objective by ~0.49.
Backend cost variance dominates the regret budget under low-load.

failed_approaches.statement: Tried greedy-cheapest-first; the deterministic choice clumps load on one backend under spike.
